what: Ulta Beauty is the largest specialty beauty retailer in the United States. Its stores sell mass-market and prestige cosmetics, skin care, fragrance and hair products side by side, and most have a salon inside.
customers: American beauty shoppers across price points, with about 45 million members in its loyalty programme.
money: cosmetics, skin care, fragrance, hair and wellness products
moat: Carrying cheap and expensive brands in the same shop, which no department store or drugstore does, plus a loyalty programme that captures most of its sales and the purchase data behind them.
risks: Sephora's expansion inside Kohl's stores increased competition directly
Prestige beauty spending softened as consumers traded down
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year with a return on invested capital of 23%
Its loyalty data lets it sell advertising to the brands on its shelves
International expansion has only just begun
watch: Comparable store sales and loyalty member growth.
